sections.title: AI Slop and the Research Quality Crisis — 24,000 Papers Submitted to ICML 2026
sections.lead: Nature officially characterized low-quality AI-generated papers as "AI slop," formalizing a quality crisis in academic publishing.

sections.title: Agent Security — Prompt Injection and Millions of ID Exposures
sections.lead: Security vulnerabilities were flagged in agent-specific social networks OpenClaw and Moltbook, including prompt injection attacks, malicious skill distribution, and the exposure of millions of agent IDs.
